jobs.title: a theme for the living room
jobs.what: A local reskin of Fireplace's room: one JSON file in client/themes (its colours, what stands on the mantel, the weather at the window), no code. node tools/themes.mjs new <id> starts one at Grandma's colours, and client/room.html?theme=<id> shows it as you save.

jobs.title: a ball or a hat for Fireplace
jobs.what: A new look players can pick on the couch, which everyone in the room sees: one entry at the end of BALLS or HATS in client/looks.mjs (a pattern and two colours, or a hat's style and colour). client/party-render-demo.html?scene=wardrobe shows every one. A new pattern or hat style is a few lines in the bumper and party shaders.

jobs.title: a Party minigame
jobs.what: A new round for Party, and so for Fireplace. node tools/new-mg.mjs <key> <prefix> "<NAME>" writes one that builds and plays (a sumo ring); make it yours. Or work on one in the browser with client/studio.html: edit its WAT and constants, build and check it there, play it against AI balls, and send it in. Ideas are in docs/roadmap.md's kits table: Snowball, Full Tilt, Big Fans, Hoop Hop, Pinball. Its tests, the determinism matrix and the online gate must pass in CI.

jobs.title: a map for the arena or Dogfight
jobs.what: A new place to fight: a folder in maps/ (map.json, height.png, surface.png), drawn in the browser with client/map-editor.html: shape and paint the ground, drag out walls and roofs, place spawns, weapon pads, teleporters, flags, hills and race gates. Put your GitHub login in its by field. node net/play.mjs --arena --map <folder> plays it with bots; send it in from the editor. CI compiles it and plays it with AI fighters (node tools/map-check.mjs).

mods.name: Skyways
